tier1.headline: Your Financial Data Collected
tier1.quote: Financial information, such as payment card data and associated fraud checks.

tier1.headline: Your Data Collected Indirectly
tier1.quote: We receive personal information from third parties such as: business partners, advertising and marketing agencies, data brokers, analytics providers, academic institutions, journal owners or societies, search information providers, and credit reference agencies.

tier2.headline: Your DNT Requests Ignored
tier2.quote: While we do not currently respond to “do not track” browser signals, users have several options to manage cookies and tracking technologies.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Widely
tier2.quote: We may share personal information with our subsidiary and affiliate companies for the purposes described in the “Use of Personal Information” section above.

tier2.headline: Your Location Data Collected
tier2.quote: This includes IP address, browser type and settings, device details, internet service provider, referring and exit pages, site content interactions, location data, and other usage information.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Is Analyzed
tier2.quote: We use tracking technologies such as cookies, web beacons, embedded scripts, location-identifying technologies, device recognition technologies, and session replay software.

tier2.headline: Your Ads Are Targeted
tier2.quote: Marketing our sites, products, or services (including through emails, newsletters, targeted advertising, phone calls, and SMS messages).

tier2.headline: Your Data Leaves Your Country
tier2.quote: We may transfer, store or process personal information in any country where Wiley or its service providers operate.

tier2.headline: Your Data Disclosed Legally
tier2.quote: We may be required to disclose personal information to meet legal requests, including national security or law enforcement requirements.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Rights Limited
tier2.quote: If we cannot fulfil your request for any reason, we will provide an explanation.
